project.name: osgi/runtime/readiness-await
project.description: The connect-retry + two-tier-deadline SKELETON the readiness edges share: reach the endpoint (retried until connectTimeout, absorbing a cold boot / image re-seed), then — while connected — hand the remaining readinessTimeout to a domain-native convergence wait. It owns the control flow both readiness edges share and NOTHING domain-specific: the event channel does not generalise (the systemd edge wakes-and-rechecks on raw dbus signals; the cluster edge lets fabric8 waitUntilCondition encapsulate the wait), so the convergence wait is the injected awaitConvergence function, not a method here. Runtime, not foundation: it is orchestration machinery the edges call, and runtime sits below the domains (scenario-engine imports no domain, the -bdd scions already compile against runtime) — so an edge depending on it is with the grain. A pure-JDK bundle (no OSGi, no domain type); staged in-container where the edges' connections live.
